title: Rule Book leaves out the agreed early end of the transfer window
steps: Open RULE BOOK from the main menu and read TRANSFER CHALLENGE. It says the window lasts 15 minutes, with no early-end exception.
Start season 1 of a 3-season Showdown with Daniel at Arsenal and Nik at Liverpool.
Start the shared 15-minute window. Daniel asks to end it early; check that the window stays open.
Nik also asks to end it early, before 15 minutes have passed. Both friends reach Guess Entry.
expected: The Rule Book says the transfer window lasts up to 15 minutes and may end early if both managers agree.
actual: The Rule Book says only that the challenge lasts 15 minutes. The game correctly allows both managers to end it early, and explains this on the transfer screen.
root_cause: The transfer screen and shared game rules already include agreement to finish early; the Rule Book sentence has not kept up.

fix.change: Replace the fixed-duration sentence with: The transfer window lasts up to 15 minutes. Both managers may agree to end it early.

script_output:
Rule Book: "The transfer window challenge lasts 15 minutes."
Game screens: Daniel requests early end; window stays open. Nik requests early end; both reach Guess Entry before 15 minutes.
Existing shared rule correctly requires both managers. The Rule Book does not mention that exception.
PROOF RESULT: Rule Book must explain the existing rule that both managers may agree to end the window early.
Exit code: 1 (the missing Rule Book explanation is the expected failed check).
assumptions: This is a minor written-rules gap; the shared early-end behavior itself is correct.
Both friends play fairly and agree to finish their transfers early.
The proof opens the unchanged game in Chromium on a local server and uses the real transfer rules behind a local game test double.
